2607.13491.title: DeepLoop: Depth Scaling for Looped Transformers
2607.13491.paper_summary: Looped Transformers scale sequential computation by applying a compact stack of physical blocks for multiple rounds, increasing unrolled depth without increasing stored parameters. This reuse changes the residual-scaling problem: in an untied Transformer, each residual branch receives and applies its own parameter update, whereas in a looped Transformer one shared update aggregates gradients from repeated visits and is read back by those same visits in the next linearized forward pass. We formalize this tied-depth effect through a first-order perturbation bound controlled by a visit-alignment coefficient $κ_R$. The bound recovers the DeepNorm exponent when visits decorrelate, but in the conservative aligned regime it requires the exponent to increase from $1/4$ to $1/2$ as loop count grows at fixed physical depth. The resulting method, \textbf{DeepLoop}, keeps the Post-LN DeepNorm architecture and sets $α=(2N)^{1/2}$ and $β=(8N)^{-1/2}$ for unrolled depth $N$. On GPT-style looped language models at GPT-2 small and GPT-2 medium scale, DeepLoop is neutral when no physical block is revisited and improves validation loss and downstream accuracy once recurrent depth is activated. These results show that stable recurrent depth requires residual scaling rules that account for parameter visits, not only nominal layer count.
2607.13491.paper_summary_zh: 循環Transformer透過應用緊湊的物理區塊堆疊進行多輪計算，從而擴展序列計算，增加未展開的深度而不增加儲存的參數。這種重用改變了殘差縮放問題：在未綁定的Transformer中，每個殘差分支接收並應用其自己的參數更新，而在循環Transformer中，一個共享的更新聚合來自重複訪問的梯度，並在下一次線性化的前向傳遞中由這些相同的訪問讀取。我們通過一個由訪問對齊係數 $κ_R$ 控制的一階擾動界限來形式化這種綁定深度效應。當訪問去相關時，這個界限恢復了 DeepNorm 指數，但在保守的對齊範疇中，隨著循環計數在固定物理深度下增長，指數需要從 $1/4$ 增加到 $1/2$。最終方法 \textbf{DeepLoop} 保持了 Post-LN DeepNorm 架構，並將 $α=(2N)^{1/2}$ 和 $β=(8N)^{-1/2}$ 設定為未展開深度 $N$。在 GPT-2 小型和 GPT-2 中型規模的 GPT 風格循環語言模型上，當沒有物理區塊被重新訪問時，DeepLoop 是中性的，並且在啟用循環深度後改善了驗證損失和下游準確性。這些結果顯示，穩定的循環深度需要考慮參數訪問的殘差縮放規則，而不僅僅是名義層數。
